sources.question: Tell me about a time your team handled a setback.
criteria: Explicar o desfecho ou a aprendizagem.

answers.text: I am not sure we would have recovered, but about 30% of the team stayed late and I coordinated the rollback, so we lost only a few customers and learned to test earlier.

segments.text: I am not sure we would have recovered.
